# Activation digest: test vectors

The byte encodings of the activation-map digest and the vectors the restore probes check (M1, M2,
K1, G1, MP1, L1 and P1; tests/probe_restore_activation_identity.m, tests/verify_restore_vectors.py
and tests/verify_restore_activation_records.py). Edit only together with the digest code
(rabbit_reconstruction_tab, `activation_digest`).

The map digest encoding is exactly om-activation-map-canonical-v1. Its input bytes are:

4f4d2d41435449564154494f4e2d4d41500063616e6f6e6963616c2d763100
|| uint32 little-endian class-tag length
|| class-tag bytes
|| uint64 little-endian rank=2
|| uint64 little-endian rows
|| uint64 little-endian columns
|| payload in MATLAB column-major order.

The header octets above are ASCII OM-ACTIVATION-MAP, 0x00, ASCII canonical-v1, 0x00. The only class tags are the exact ASCII bytes single = 73 69 6e 67 6c 65 and double = 64 6f 75 62 6c 65. single payload values are IEEE-754 binary32 little-endian; double payload values are IEEE-754 binary64 little-endian. NaN is replaced by binary32 bits 7fc00000 or binary64 bits 7ff8000000000000 before little-endian encoding. -0 is replaced by +0 bits. Infinities are never eligible and therefore have no eligible map digest. Host-memory bytes are never the semantic digest.

Normative map vectors are part of this contract. M1 is single 2x2, column-major values [1,-0,NaN,2]. Its exact input bytes are 4f4d2d41435449564154494f4e2d4d41500063616e6f6e6963616c2d7631000600000073696e676c650200000000000000020000000000000002000000000000000000803f000000000000c07f00000040 and its SHA-256 is 57712e409e8978f37fd6f50fdd9cd0cf0c294042acac1cca84c38ae89c6d671b. M1 is available with finite_count=3,nan_count=1,pos_inf_count=0,neg_inf_count=0. M2 is double 1x3, column-major values [0,-0,NaN]. Its exact input bytes are 4f4d2d41435449564154494f4e2d4d41500063616e6f6e6963616c2d76310006000000646f75626c6502000000000000000100000000000000030000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000f87f and its SHA-256 is 0c5570e7caf409a9ba36ceb427ac2b5641fc190a388f2f6eb9ff5e66186d46a5. M3 is single 2x1 [Inf,-Inf] and must be rejected with pos_inf_count=1,neg_inf_count=1; M4 is double 1x2 [NaN,NaN] and must be rejected with NO_FINITE_VALUES. These vectors test class, shape, column-major order, signed zero, partial/all NaN, and both infinities.

method is exactly {name:"activation_time_pipeline",version:"method-v1",parameters_json:<JCS UTF-8 object string>,parameters_sha256:<64 lowercase hex>}. Parsing parameters_json must yield exactly {schema:"method-parameters-v1",operation,parent_map_digest,parent_time_reference,parameters} and no other keys. operation is one of load, spatial_filter, manual_zero, undo. For load, parent_map_digest:null, parent_time_reference:null, and parameters is exactly {kind:"load",source_recording_identity_sha256:<64 lowercase hex>,initial_time_reference:<complete non-unknown root time_reference>}. For spatial_filter, parent_map_digest and parent_time_reference are the complete immediately preceding map digest and time-reference object, and parameters is exactly {kind:"spatial_filter",filter_schema:"spatial-filter-v1",kernel_class:<single or double>,kernel_rank:<positive unsigned-integer string>,kernel_dimensions:[<positive unsigned-integer strings>],kernel_order:"column-major",kernel_sha256:<64 lowercase hex>,source_pin:"spatial-filter-v1-reference",source_version:"1",boundary:"preserve_nan",normalisation:"none"}; kernel_rank equals the number of dimensions and the value count equals their product. For manual_zero, parent_map_digest and parent_time_reference are required and parameters is exactly {kind:"manual_zero",reference_coordinate:{kind:<one of first_frame,stimulus,reference_frame,earliest_activation>,anchor_frame:<constrained unsigned-integer string>},offset_sign:"subtract",offset_ms:<finite double bit string>}; these values must equal the resulting relative_to_manual_zero record. For undo, parent_map_digest and parent_time_reference are required and parameters is exactly {kind:"undo",restored_map_digest:<64 lowercase hex>,restored_time_reference:<complete prior time_reference object>}. The only accepted parent-time value is the complete object, including its recursive parent history; null is accepted only for load. Unknown operations, parameters, keys, literals, or omitted status-dependent fields are rejected. The parameters digest is SHA-256 over ASCII OM-ACTIVATION-METHOD, NUL, method-v1, NUL, followed by the UTF-8 JCS bytes of parameters_json, with no circular self-inclusion.
For spatial_filter, kernel_sha256 is SHA-256 over the bytes ASCII OM-SPATIAL-FILTER-KERNEL, NUL, spatial-filter-v1, NUL, then uint32 little-endian byte length and ASCII bytes of the class tag (single or double), uint64 little-endian rank, one uint64 little-endian dimension per rank entry in declared order, uint32 little-endian byte length and ASCII bytes of source_pin, uint32 little-endian byte length and ASCII bytes of source_version, and the finite kernel payload in MATLAB column-major order as IEEE-754 binary32 or binary64 little-endian values. The only source_pin is spatial-filter-v1-reference and its only source_version is 1. Dimensions are positive uint64 strings; the rank, class, order, and payload length are all checked. NaN and positive or negative infinity kernel values are rejected with no digest; finite -0 is canonicalised to +0 before encoding, so NaN policy is reject and signed-zero policy is +0. K1 is the double rank-2 2x2 column-major kernel [1,-0,2,3] under this exact source/version pin; its canonical payload uses +0. K1.input_hex="4f4d2d5350415449414c2d46494c5445522d4b45524e454c007370617469616c2d66696c7465722d76310006000000646f75626c650200000000000000020000000000000002000000000000001b0000007370617469616c2d66696c7465722d76312d7265666572656e63650100000031000000000000f03f000000000000000000000000000000400000000000000840" and K1.sha256="f40ed5aecbac11397bb3dd102286065af9c666d2f559bf06da4aac139ae76a0c".

The authoritative activation_provenance is exactly the provenance payload fields plus provenance_digest. The payload is a closed object with exactly {schema:"provenance-v1",map_kind,units,method,time_reference,recording_identity,geometry,geometry_digest,projection_contract,projection_contract_digest,projected_output,map_summary,map_digest}; its values are the complete records defined in sections 5–10, not locator strings or independently re-derived labels. provenance_digest is SHA-256 over ASCII OM-ACTIVATION-PROVENANCE, NUL, provenance-v1, NUL, followed by the UTF-8 JCS bytes of that complete payload. The digest therefore has no circular provenance_digest field and is the complete source/provenance digest captured in the origin tuple. A map mutation is a single state transaction: load, spatial filter, manual zero, and undo stage the new map and its complete current provenance together. If reprojection succeeds in the same transaction, the result is AVAILABLE with a newly matching projected_output; otherwise the result is exactly MUTATION_PENDING_REPROJECTION with the current map/provenance retained and projected_output set to its closed UNAVAILABLE form, so the old projection is unavailable and cannot be consumed. No stale AVAILABLE projected_output may remain. The transaction validates both records and publishes the pair under one state lock/event-queue turn. If validation fails, neither member changes. A filter recomputes summary and map digest and appends its exact canonical method parameters; manual zero recomputes summary and digest and replaces time_reference with the exact relative_to_manual_zero record; undo swaps the map with its saved provenance pair, never the array alone. A missing or stale provenance pair invalidates the map atomically. Reprojection captures the pair only at a successful state linearisation point and includes provenance_digest in the activation_map field-level CAS.
The persisted activation_map wire is one flattened, closed representation of that provenance and has no hidden or transient third representation. Its AVAILABLE and MUTATION_PENDING_REPROJECTION forms both include schema:"activation-map-v1", status, map_kind, units, method, time_reference, recording_identity, geometry, projection_contract, map_summary, map_digest, geometry_digest, projection_contract_digest, projected_output, and provenance_digest. provenance_digest is persisted, is recomputed from the exact provenance payload above, and is included in the activation_map field CAS digest. A reader rejects any omission, extra key, mismatched digest, or attempt to reconstruct the digest from labels or host state.

Normative non-map digest vectors are fixed here, not deferred to E3. Each `.json` value below is the complete RFC 8785 JCS object string (UTF-8, no surrounding whitespace); each `.input_hex` value is the exact domain-separator bytes followed by that UTF-8 string; each `.sha256` is the expected lowercase SHA-256 of those input bytes. G1 is a complete geometry-v1 object. MP1 is a complete method-parameters-v1 object for manual_zero and is the value of parameters_json in a method-v1 record. L1 is the complete parsed lineage-v1 payload; its outer lineage record uses encoding jcs-utf8-v1, json equal to this string, and sha256 equal to L1.sha256. P1 is a complete projection-contract-v1 object, including the target mesh identity and resolved COLMAP pose records. The placeholder-looking digest values in these vectors are intentional fixed test bytes, not claims about project artefacts.

The geometry, method, lineage, and projection digest rules, including their separator octets, typed values, and normative vectors, are normative inputs rather than prose suggestions. E3 must recompute them with an independent consumer.
